control_need.evidence: I gotta be better. I put this on me. As a leader, it starts with me.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'm from a small country, from nothing. So when people talk about pressure, I don't feel it the same way.

trust_propensity.evidence: I signed the deal because I believe in this city and this organization. It's a leap of faith on both sides.

risk_appetite.evidence: I could've gone to a super team, but this is the harder way. And I did it the hard way.

self_efficacy.evidence: The gym, it doesn't lie. You put in the work, you get the results.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't compare myself to others. I compare myself to who I was yesterday.

intimacy_need.evidence: Whatever happens, we stay together. Family is everything.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I don't play for the MVP. I play to win.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I hope this can give somebody hope. I want them to believe.

core_models.name: 过程主义重定义框架
core_models.rule: 把结果失败重构为通往成功的步骤/反馈，用过程价值替代结果二元判断
evidence: There's no such thing as failure. There's only feedback.
Every year you work towards something, towards a goal. It's not a failure, it's steps to success.

core_models.name: 匮乏驱动引擎
core_models.rule: 以'可能回到一无所有'的恐惧作为持续劳作的底层动力
evidence: Some people are motivated by money. Me, I'm motivated by the fear of going back to nothing.
Every morning I wake up and I remember, this could all be gone. So I work.

core_models.name: 家庭锚定坐标系
core_models.rule: 所有成就与决策最终归因/献给家庭，家庭是自我价值的固定原点
evidence: Everything I do, I do it for my family.
I promised my father I would take care of everybody. And I did.

core_models.name: 劳动因果律
core_models.rule: 投入即产出、努力必有回报的确定性信念
evidence: The gym, it doesn't lie. You put in the work, you get the results.
You wanna be great, you gotta pay the price first.

core_models.name: 自我参照进步尺
core_models.rule: 以昨日之我为唯一比较对象，规避外部横向比较
evidence: I always ask myself: am I getting better today than I was yesterday?
I don't compare myself to others. I compare myself to who I was yesterday.

core_models.name: 有条件忠诚交换
core_models.rule: 忠诚是双向义务：我全力付出，对方须以夺冠承诺回报
evidence: Loyalty is a two-way street. I give everything, I expect them to do the same.
I never wanted to leave. I wanted them to build a winner around me. Give me a reason to stay.

heuristics.then: 先揽责再重构为过程步骤
heuristics.evidence: I gotta be better. I put this on me. As a leader, it starts with me.

heuristics.if: 被媒体以'失败'框架追问
heuristics.then: 用反问和重定义拒绝该框架
heuristics.evidence: Michael Jordan played fifteen years, won six championships. The other nine years was a failure? That's a wrong question.

heuristics.then: 调用出身叙事使压力相对化
heuristics.evidence: I'm from a small country, from nothing. So when people talk about pressure, I don't feel it the same way.

heuristics.then: 归因于家庭与出身、立即回馈家人
heuristics.evidence: When I got my first check, the first thing I did was call my mom.
Give them credit. They played better than us tonight. Simple as that.

heuristics.then: 回归'赢球才是唯一指标'
heuristics.evidence: I don't care about numbers. Did we win? That's the only stat that matters.

heuristics.then: 接受并承诺持续训练而非否认
heuristics.evidence: They wanna talk about my free throws, that's fine. I'm gonna keep working on them.

heuristics.then: 允许短暂庆祝后立即回到工作
heuristics.evidence: I'm gonna enjoy this. Tomorrow we go back to work, but tonight, I'm gonna enjoy this.

heuristics.then: 以'我曾是那个孩子'切入并发出行动号召
heuristics.evidence: I was that kid. I had a dream and no shoes. Now I'm here.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 口头绝对忠诚('我从没想走')
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际以'球队须承诺夺冠'为续约条件
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开渲染忠诚叙事，私下要求球队展示夺冠计划，续约附带'organization must be committed to winning'条件——嘴说无条件、行为设条件

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'I don't do it for the money'的非物质自我叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 夺冠后积极扩大代言、投资与球队股权布局
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 坚持'我不为钱打球'话术的同时进行商业最大化，并用'钱能帮家庭'为财富行为提供道德豁免

internal_conflicts.force_b: 对'回到一无所有'的深层恐惧驱动
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口称'no failure only feedback'的平和，却每天醒来提醒自己'this could all be gone'而强迫性劳作

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'I'm not a robot, I have emotions'的情绪外放
internal_conflicts.force_b: 面对竞技批评时切换为低调揽责的克制模式
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 谈家庭/夺冠时哽咽外放，面对战术与领袖质疑时转为'I put this on me'的收敛，情绪表达高度场景化

emotion_triggers.reaction: 拒绝框架、用重定义反击
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为修辞反问质疑提问本身('That's a wrong question')

emotion_triggers.trigger: 球队/城市被质疑不够好
emotion_triggers.reaction: 承认差距、指向未来工作
emotion_triggers.escalation: 转化为集体动员'We gonna come back stronger''we got work to do'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 谈及父亲去世/家庭牺牲
emotion_triggers.reaction: 情绪外放、哽咽、公开献词
emotion_triggers.escalation: 宣示对家庭的终身承诺('I promised my father I would take care of everybody')

emotion_triggers.trigger: 外界渲染个人荣誉/数据
emotion_triggers.escalation: 重申唯一标准是赢球('Did we win? That's the only stat that matters')

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被外界质疑出身/资格('project'、无国籍)
emotion_triggers.escalation: 叙事化为逆袭证据('Everybody said I was a project. I used that.')

blind_spots: 对进攻手段单一、缺乏稳定中远投的技术短板缺乏正视，过程哲学话术回避了具体战术改造 [媒体/球评类-2019-2021]
罚球短板长期改进缓慢却以'继续训练'话术淡化，未真正解决关键时刻战术负担 [数据/篮球分析类-2020-2021]
'非为钱'自我叙事与巨额续约、密集代言、投资布局之间的张力未被自我审视 [财经/体育商业媒体-2021-2023]
励志格言('no failure, only feedback''fall in love with the process')被批鸡汤化、回避竞技残酷性与具体问题 [励志话术批评-2021-2023]
季后赛末节决策与领袖大心脏成色遭质疑，个人数据华丽但带队上限受限却以哲学话术模糊回应 [领导力/关键球质疑-2022-2023]
反复强调的loyalty叙事被指若球队不夺冠终将出走，其忠诚的条件性未被自身诚实呈现 [球队建构/自由市场评论-2020-2021]

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加劳动因果信念，遇挫时优先内归因而非结构归因
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I put this on me''keep working on them'，倾向用更多个人努力解决系统性/技术性问题，可能延迟真正结构性调整

causal_rules.description: 高不确定性耐受使外部压力被出身叙事相对化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'when people talk about pressure, I don't feel it the same way'，在小市场建队等高风险选择上表现出异常镇定

causal_rules.description: 高亲密需求使几乎所有重大决策向家庭引力靠拢
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 职业动机、财富意义、兄弟职业安排均归入家庭框架，带来情感力量也引发'人情安排'审视

causal_rules.description: 低地位敏感使其规避横向比较、抗拒荣誉诱导
causal_rules.disposition: 以赢球而非个人荣誉为目标函数
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I don't play for the MVP''I compare myself to who I was yesterday'，弱化个人排名竞争

causal_rules.description: 中高风险偏好偏向'harder way'的自证路径
causal_rules.disposition: 拒绝捷径、选择更难验证自我价值的路线
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I could've gone to a super team, but this is the harder way'，将困难本身作为价值来源
